name: Website Auditor
description: Crawls a website and produces a brand, UX, and SEO audit report.

nodes.label: Audit Trigger
nodes.description: Starts the audit for a given URL.

nodes.label: Web Crawler
nodes.description: Crawls the target website and collects page snapshots.

nodes.label: Brand Audit Agent
nodes.description: Evaluates brand consistency, tone, and visual identity across pages.

nodes.label: UX Audit Agent
nodes.description: Evaluates usability, navigation clarity, and CTA effectiveness.

nodes.label: SEO Audit Agent
nodes.description: Evaluates meta tags, headings, alt text, and keyword presence.

nodes.label: Evidence Evaluator
nodes.description: Checks that audit findings are grounded in crawled evidence.

nodes.label: Report Synthesizer
nodes.description: Combines brand, UX, and SEO findings into a single audit report.

nodes.label: Final Audit Report
nodes.description: The complete audit report as a markdown file.
